use.reason: For an odd p, a character of the cyclic two-primary part of F_p^times can send its unique element of order two to minus one; the trivial character gives plus one. Pull back along reduction. At2 use the trivial or modulo-four character. Thus the prescribed sign is achieved without assuming it for an arbitrary character. The integral projectors preserve the selected-line convention; their support is supplied by the separate split-support application.

use.reason: The construction chooses hstar split at old primes including2N, so its character is trivial locally there. The selected q is odd and excluded from the support of hstar; the quadratic algebra has discriminant hstar, so it is unramified at q. The specified Frobenius condition gives chi_hstar(q)=-1. An unramified character is trivial on units, hence its value on an element of valuation v is chi_hstar(p)^v. This supplies the norm values for the separately proved valuations e and1.

use.reason: For P over F_(q^2), choose2^M Q=P and define kappa(P)=F_q^2 Q-Q. The stage makes F_q^2 trivial on torsion, so the map is well defined and additive. It commutes with F_q, whose action on torsion is C; composing with b gives lambda(F_q P)=lambda(P). This is exactly the same map for every term, not a newly chosen functional for each CM point. Rationality of the coarse points in its domain is supplied separately by the coarse-descent input.
